title: When Does an Interpretation Count as Established? The Formation, Evaluation, and Responsibility of Interpretation in Generative AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.04766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI research has increasingly evaluated factuality, citation, coverage, and report structure. Yet passing such local checks does not by itself show that a humanistic interpretation has been established. This paper asks how an interpretation comes to be recognized within sociotechnical processes. It introduces three connected concepts. Interpretive appearance names the gap between the finished form of an output and the publicly traceable process through which materials, counterevidence, and revisions constrained the judgment. The evaluation contract names the bounded materials, tasks, criteria, permitted inferences, and failure conditions within which a local judgment is valid. Standing substitution names the unwarranted conversion of a genuine local pass into a stronger claim that an interpretation, result, or research capability has been established, without commensurate new evidence or bridging arguments. translated_title: 何时一种解释才算成立？生成式AI中解释的形成、评估与责任
translated_abstract: 生成式AI研究日益注重对事实性、引用、覆盖面和报告结构的评估。然而，仅仅通过这些局部检查本身并不能证明一个人文解释已经成立。本文探讨一种解释如何在社会技术过程中获得认可，并引入了三个相互关联的概念。“解释表象”指输出的完成形态与公开可追溯过程之间的差距，后者展示了材料、反证和修订如何约束了判断。“评估契约”指有界的材料、任务、标准、允许的推理和失败条件，局部判断仅在这些范围内有效。“地位替换”指将真实的局部通过不当转换为更强的主张——即某一解释、结果或研究能力已经确立——而无需相应的新证据或桥接论证。论文随后检
tldr: 本文提出“解释表象”“评估契约”和“地位替换”三个概念，论证生成式AI输出通过局部事实性检查并不等于人文解释已确立，解释的成立需要在社会技术过程中具备公开可追溯的证据与论证支撑。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces three concepts—interpretive appearance, the evaluation contract, and standing substitution—to argue that passing local factuality checks in generative AI does not by itself establish a humanistic interpretation, which instead requires publicly traceable evidence and bridging arguments within sociotechnical processes.
